title: Binary Search
description:
Implement `binarySearch(arr, target)` that searches a sorted array for `target` and returns its index, or `-1` if not found. Must run in O(log n).

**Example:**
```js
binarySearch([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 5); // 2
binarySearch([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 4); // -1
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using lo < hi instead of lo <= hi (misses the single-element case), and integer overflow with (lo + hi) / 2 (use (lo + hi) >>> 1 or lo + Math.floor((hi - lo) / 2)).
